response: {"thought": "依語意層定義，取消率分子為狀態 9，分母為狀態 1、2、3、9（不含待付款 0），並以訂單成立時間（order_ts）歸屬 2025 年 11 月。接著用 SQL 計算並檢查各狀態筆數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_n, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denom_n, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1,2,3,9) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS cancel_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_excluded_n, COUNT(*) AS total_in_month FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < '2025-12-01 00:00:00'"}}
